decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority (before the building(s) is/are occupied/used).
Condition : 4 - The four proposed rooflights shall be of a flush fitting Conservation Area type unless otherwise agreed in writing by the local planning authority.

Condition : 5 - It is considered that this application for the erection of a side and rear dormer window, and additional rooflight to the existing dwelling, would not be detrimental to the appearance of the original dwelling, the character of the Conservation Areas or to the amenities of the adjoining and neighbouring properties.  On balance, the development is in accordance with Policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development) ENV.B.2.2 (Conservation Areas) and H.6.4 (Extensions and Alterations) of the London Borough of Hounslow UDP, Adopted December 2003; and is generally compliant with Council's Residential Extension Guidelines.  It is considered that where the development is not compliant there are no undue adverse effects resulting from this.
description: Erection of side and rear dormer roof extension, incorporating two roof lights to front elevation of roof to dwellinghouse.
